fixed.summary: The hero button tells the engine its variant: primary for its default and premium tones, secondary and danger for theirs. A style pack can now tell a secondary hero button from the default one in `button.secondary::part(HeroButton\.base)` and `button.primary::part(HeroButton\.base)`; before, every hero button was a variant-less (secondary) button, so the default tone matched `.secondary` too.
